evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth: 2.90→3.22 Torr (k=20..25) while Ar flow and T are on setpoint; prior stages were stable near 2.94
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) or an equivalent test — e.g. a brief Ar step-change/pump-down response or valve-position readback — to distinguish a seal leak (air ingress) from a downstream exhaust restriction.
